subject: world_language
concept: Adapting register, tone, and style seamlessly across radically different contexts (casual, academic, poetic, technical)
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.pictorial: Student rewrites the same content in four radically different registers/styles
exercise.abstract: Student produces the same core message convincingly across at least two very different registers or styles in the target language

assessment.mastery_threshold: both register versions are convincingly and consistently maintained throughout
misconception_flags: begins in one register but drifts back to a more familiar one partway through

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
target_language: configurable — student/parent selects target language at enrollment
